#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
const int MI = 1e9;
const long long ML = 1e18;

struct Reader {
    std::stringstream ss;
    std::istream& in;
    Reader() : in(std::cin) {}
    bool isReady() { return in.rdbuf()->in_avail() != 0; }
    std::string next() {
        std::string token;
        if (!(in >> token)) return "";
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() { int x; in >> x; return x; }
    long long nextLong() { long long x; in >> x; return x; }
    std::vector<int> nextIntArray(int n) {
        std::vector<int> arr(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) arr[i] = nextInt();
        return arr;
    }
    std::string nextLine() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(in, line);
        return line;
    }
};

void printfOutput(const std::string& s) {
    std::cout << s;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    class Main {
    public:
        string answer;
        void solve() {
            Reader in;
            int w = in.nextInt();
            int m = in.nextInt();
            if (w <= 3) {
                answer += "YES";
                return;
            }
            long long limit = (long long)1e10;
            long long x = 1;
            std::vector<long long> list;
            do {
                list.push_back(x);
                x *= w;
            } while (x <= limit);
            int n = (int)list.size();
            // For each subset
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
                long long v = m;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (mask & (1 << j))
                        v += list[j];
                }
                for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; --j) {
                    if (!(mask & (1 << j))) {
                        if (v - list[j] >= 0)
                            v -= list[j];
                    }
                }
                if (v == 0) {
                    answer += "YES";
                    return;
                }
            }
            answer += "NO";
        }
        void run() {
            solve();
        }
        void printf() {
            printfOutput(answer);
        }
    } obj;
    obj.run();
    obj.printf();
    return 0;
}
